meta.title: Yard sale — my things looking for a new home
meta.description: I'm moving and selling what isn't coming with me. Check the photos and prices, then message me to arrange pickup.

hero.subtitle: I'm moving and my things are looking for a new home.
hero.lead: Everything here has been well looked after and needs a new place before the move. Have a look, pick what suits you and message me — we'll set a day for you to pick it up.

steps.title: Pick
steps.text: Browse the items and check the photos and details.

steps.title: Message me
steps.text: On WhatsApp, by text or with a call — just tap the item.

steps.title: Arrange pickup
steps.text: You collect it on a day and time that works for both of us.

items.title: What's here
items.empty: I'm still sorting things out. Check back soon!
items.sold: This one found a new owner 💛
items.message: Hi! I saw "{title}" in your yard sale and I'm interested.

pickup: Pickup is on you, and payment happens at pickup. If you have questions about size or condition, just ask!
